test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no. 7.
solution:
The correct answer is 'much.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Much, many, few and little** are all words that come before nouns to help explain them.
 
• Both **much and many** suggest a large quantity of something, whilst **little and few** mean: not as much, or not as many.
 
• Use **much** if the noun is non-countable (e.g., water, sand).
